title: Skipping Consecutive Record Groups
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input string, $b$ a four-tape interpreter configuration on $x$, $i$ a record index from $0$ through $8$, and $T$ a table decomposed as $T=lGr$, where $G$ is the concatenation of the serialized records in a list of groups, each group containing exactly nine actions. For any natural number $n$, let the state tape have a marker at position $0$ and unary cells in the window from $j+1$ through $j+g$, where $j$ is the number of already consumed unary cells and $g$ is the number of groups; then, after $g+|G|+1$ interpreter steps from the record-group phase at table cursor $|l|$ and state cursor $j+1$, the interpreter is in the state-rewind phase remembering $i$, with table cursor $|l|+|G|$, state tape corresponding to $j+g$ consumed cells and no remaining unary cells, and state cursor $j+g+1$.
hypotheses_covered: Base configuration $b$ of the four-tape interpreter on $x$
Record index $i$ is an index from $0$ through $8$
List of action groups, with every group having length nine
Table decomposition $T=l++G++r$, where $G$ concatenates the groups' serialized records
caveat: The formal statement does not assume the state tape has unary cells in the indicated window; it specifies the tape explicitly as the function $z\mapsto 0$ at $0$, $1$ when $j<z\le j+g$, and blank elsewhere. It also does not quantify over $n$.
replaced:
Suppose the table is $l \cdot G \cdot r$, where $G$ concatenates the
serialized transition records of $g$ groups of one-work-tape machine
actions, each group containing exactly nine records, and suppose the state
tape is the state window with $j$ erased and $g$ remaining unary cells,
with state cursor $j + 1$.  From the interpreter's record-group phase
carrying a read index $i \in \{0, \dots, 8\}$, with table cursor $|l|$,
exactly $g + |G| + 1$ interpreter steps reach the state-rewind phase
remembering $i$, with table cursor $|l| + |G|$, state tape the state window
with $j + g$ erased and no remaining unary cells, and state cursor
$j + g + 1$: each remaining unary state symbol is erased at the cost of one
step plus a nine-record skip, and the terminating blank costs one further
step.
